question: In a clinical study to evaluate the efficacy of a new medication in the treatment of migraine crisis (point out the CORRECT):

options.opa: Strict inclusion criteria increase the external validity of the study.
options.opb: Strict exclusion criteria reduce the internal validity of the study.
options.opc: Control with a placebo arm increases the external validity of the study.
options.opd: Masking reduces the internal validity of the study.
options.ope: Randomization increases the internal validity of the study.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Randomization" -> "equal distribution of confounding variables" -> "reduced bias" -> "increased internal validity" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Strict inclusion criteria" -> "homogeneous study population" -> "reduced generalizability" -> "decreased external validity" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Strict exclusion criteria" -> "homogeneous study population" -> "increased internal validity" -> 80%
CHAIN: "Control with a placebo arm" -> "comparison to treatment effect" -> "increased internal validity" -> 90%
analysis: Randomization is a key method used in clinical trials to increase internal validity by reducing selection bias and ensuring that the groups being compared are similar in all respects except for the intervention being tested. This helps in attributing differences in outcomes directly to the intervention rather than other confounding factors.
